title: The African Languages Lab: A Collaborative Approach to Advancing Low-Resource African NLP

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying research representation disparities through publication volume analysis of high-resource versus African languages, and evaluating translation performance gaps using metrics like BLEU, ChrF++, and COMET on base LLMs and Google Translate compared to fine-tuned models across 31 low-resource African languages to demonstrate technological marginalization.
